facts.claim: Louisville Water Company Bid 26-06 awarded Mueller Co. LLC a resilient seated gate and wheel valve contract for an initial term Feb. 23, 2026-Feb. 22, 2027. Mueller's bid total was $669,982.59 against a $600,000 estimate and was lower than four named competing bidders.
facts.materiality: Independent utility procurement award supplies realized municipal demand and competitive pricing context relevant to the unresolved MWA contradiction without adjudicating it.

risks: Single utility award is not representative of total MWA demand or conversion.
unknowns: Actual order drawdown versus bid total is not established by the award sheet.
